_comment: ImageName -> what the picture is built from, for /create-image-refs. character/scene/props name fragments in .art/fragments/<type>s/<id>.json. action is the one thing only this picture shows; outfit (optional) overrides the character's default clothing; framing and finish apply to the whole picture. An entry with anchor: true defines a character and is never recomposed.

CMC_Miller.use: village board card, NPC agent and VillageSpriteName in Patcher/CottageResidentSchedulePatch.cs

CMC_Miller_Inn.action: relaxing after a day at the mill, standing at a plank table in the common room holding a foaming tankard of ale, a platter of roast meat and carrots on the table beside him, the stone fireplace glowing behind him

CMC_Miller_Academy.action: studying at the Academy, seated on a wooden chair at one of the workbenches, reading a thick leather-bound book held open in both hands with a look of concentration, metal ingots and a hammer on the bench beside him

CMC_Miller_Cottage.action: off duty at home in the evening, seated in a wooden chair beside the hearth, holding a steaming clay mug in both hands with a relaxed smile, a folded plaid blanket over the chair arm
CMC_Miller_Cottage.outfit: off-duty house clothes, no apron and no flour dust: a soft faded slate-blue linen shirt, untucked with the sleeves rolled, and brown work trousers
